data_fields.name: location_privilege_groups
data_fields.donor_constant: clan hall group 5 flags (1024 to 16384); castle group 8 flags (32768 to 4194304)

best_idea: a guild rank as one bit-mask of single-bit rights, with an edit refused by the server unless the editor holds MANAGE_RANKS and cannot grant a bit the editor does not hold
decision_why: keep the one-bit-per-right mask and the no-grant-above-own-rights rule; drop the 22-flag, three-group clan-hall and castle layout until Frankendom has guilds that own places; the brief's rulings do not cover guilds, so this is a design input
acceptance: a server test shows that a member without MANAGE_RANKS gets a refused edit, that an officer cannot grant a bit they lack (refused), and that an officer's valid edit is saved and read back identically
